description: Scrape GitHub trending repos and developers, search public repositories, list an org or user's repos, or fetch full repository details.

aiOnly.description: Keep repositories related to AI, machine learning, LLMs, computer vision and related topics (all repository modes).
aiOnly.title: AI / ML repositories only

customLanguage.description: Optional free-text GitHub language name that overrides the dropdown above (e.g. `Blade`, `QML`, `Tcl`).
customLanguage.title: Custom language

customSpokenLanguage.description: Optional ISO 639-1 code that overrides the spoken language dropdown (e.g. `fi`, `uk`, `vi`).
customSpokenLanguage.title: Custom spoken language

filterTopics.description: Keep repositories with at least one of these GitHub topics (e.g. `llm`, `rag`, `pytorch`). Empty = no topic filter.
filterTopics.title: Topics filter

includeContributors.description: Fetch the top 10 contributors for each repository (mode=repoDetails). Adds one request per repository.
includeContributors.title: Include contributors

includeDeveloperProfiles.description: Fetch bio, followers, public repo count, company and location for each trending developer (mode=developers). Adds one request per developer.
includeDeveloperProfiles.title: Include developer profiles

includeForks.description: Include forked repositories in search, org and user results. Off by default for a clean signal.
includeForks.title: Include forks

includeLanguages.description: Fetch the byte-count language breakdown for each repository (mode=repoDetails). Adds one request per repository.
includeLanguages.title: Include language breakdown

includeReadme.description: Fetch each repository's README as markdown (mode=repoDetails). Adds one download per repository.
includeReadme.title: Include README

language.description: Restrict results to one programming language (all modes except developers; trending uses the language's trending page).
language.title: Programming language

maxItems.description: Maximum number of records to return. GitHub search, org and user modes cap at 1,000 results; Trending exposes about 25 per page.
maxItems.title: Maximum records

minStars.description: Drop repositories with fewer stars than this. Set 0 to disable.
minStars.title: Minimum stars

mode.description: What to fetch: GitHub Trending repositories, trending developers, keyword search, an organization's repos, a user's repos, or specific repository details.
mode.title: Mode

org.description: GitHub organization login or profile URL (mode=orgRepos).
org.title: Organization

pushedWithinDays.description: Only repositories with a push in the last N days. Set 0 to disable (365 = one year).
pushedWithinDays.title: Pushed within (days)

repoUrls.description: Repository links or `owner/repo` paths, one per line (mode=repoDetails).
repoUrls.title: Repository URLs

searchQuery.description: Keywords to search in repository names, descriptions and READMEs (mode=search). GitHub search syntax such as `language:` or `topic:` also works.
searchQuery.title: Search query

since.description: Time window for trending repositories and developers (mode=trending / developers).
since.title: Trending period

sortBy.description: Result order for search, org and user modes. `Best match` uses GitHub relevance; other values rank by that metric.
sortBy.title: Sort by

spokenLanguage.description: Only show trending repos whose README is written in this language (mode=trending).
spokenLanguage.title: Spoken language

user.description: GitHub user login or profile URL (mode=userRepos).
user.title: User

title: GitHub Trending, Repository Search & Org Repo Finder Input
